sections.title: Reflex Actions and Human Nervous System
learning_goals: Understand what a reflex action is and its importance.
Trace the pathway of a reflex arc.

sections.title: Coordination in Plants
learning_goals: Explain different types of tropic movements in plants.

Describe the role of each hormone in plant growth and development.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Plant movements and hormonal effects can be visually demonstrated through time-lapse videos or animations.

sections.title: Animal Hormones: Brain and Neck Glands
learning_goals: Define hormones and their general function.

learning_goals: Identify the adrenal gland and explain the role of adrenaline.

Understand the roles of testes (testosterone) and ovaries (estrogen, progesterone) in reproduction and development.
